hotel_1star_semantic.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Cape Town? Hotel Prices for Cape Town, South Africa | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_semantic.evidenceText: The exact-city page reports an average price of $69 for 1-star hotels in Cape Town based on 38 hotels, with a median of $55. It describes one-night hotel-price ranges and states that all hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes. The page does not explicitly state that the statistic is for a room for two people or two adults.
hotel_1star_semantic.occupancyEvidence: No explicit two-person, two-adult, or room-occupancy basis appears on the opened page; a generic one-night hotel price is not sufficient.
hotel_1star_semantic.taxEvidence: The page states that all hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_semantic.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled yesterday; page says prices change based on seasons.
hotel_1star_semantic.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Cape Town South Africa 1-star hotel average price room for two taxes fees
hotel_1star_semantic.reason: Exact city/class, numeric average, one-night context, currency, and tax exclusion were found, but explicit two-person occupancy is absent. Source-default or unspecified occupancy fails this semantic experiment.
